thesis: November 11, 2026, premarket: HOLD the independent $1,000 virtual stock portfolio in cash. The current GitHub state shows $1,000 cash, no positions, no pending orders and three already processed stock HOLDs (November 6, 9 and 10); there is no asset to SELL and no outstanding BUY to duplicate. The collector last succeeded November 11 at 09:28:09 UTC with no reported errors, but its stock OHLC marks are completed NOVEMBER 10 bars, not live November 11 executable quotes: SPY $749.92, QQQ $674.76, NVDA $168.89, MSFT $533.16, AAPL $348.51, AMZN $270.87, GOOGL $287.38, TSLA $379.78. The passive $1,000 SPY benchmark began November 4 at $766.81 and is marked $977.973664 at November 10, versus $1,000 in cash, an approximately $22.03 / 2.20% cash-over-benchmark difference over just four sessions; this is not evidence of predictive skill. November 10 hot October CPI (headline +0.4% month on month versus +0.3% expected) and hawkish Federal Reserve commentary increased expected December rate hikes; Reuters and AP report Tuesday declines of roughly 0.4% for S&P 500 and 0.7% for Nasdaq, with Nvidia particularly weak. The bullish countercase is real: Reuters November 11 premarket reports CoreWeave's strong results and demand outlook lifting AI infrastructure sentiment, with S&P 500 futures about +0.86%, Nasdaq 100 futures +1.9%, and NVDA indicated +5.2% at 06:39 ET. Yet these futures/premarket snapshots are not synchronized executable prices and may reverse; the market has rapidly alternated between AI optimism and valuation/regulatory concerns, while unexpectedly persistent inflation increases discount-rate risk. CoreWeave is not among this account's supported symbols; chasing its premarket move via QQQ or NVDA would substitute correlated exposure for an independently tested signal. An SPY purchase offers diversification and may outperform cash over a long horizon, but the experiment's short forward-only decision horizon, recent volatility, lack of a quantified conditional edge net of modeled costs, and uncertainty around today's cash-versus-equity risk make a new purchase an unsupported discretionary bet. Prior repeated HOLDs are not a strategy by themselves; reassess explicitly when fresh completed bars and credible valuation/catalyst evidence change the trade-off. No execution or fill is asserted.
risk_notes: Main HOLD risk is opportunity cost: a sustained post-CoreWeave AI rebound could make cash materially underperform SPY or QQQ, and indefinite cash holding would be inappropriate for an objective requiring long-term market participation. Conversely hot inflation, higher expected policy rates, AI capital-spending valuation sensitivity, NVDA-specific headline risk and rapid premarket reversals could punish new longs. Company-specific filings, forward valuations, and executable intraday prices were not independently validated sufficiently to estimate a positive net-of-cost edge for AAPL, AMZN, GOOGL, MSFT, NVDA or TSLA.
